scope: Native Android implementation only; no Dart, gateway/model configuration, signing, release or remote writes

channels.encoding: StandardMessageCodec string-keyed maps; generations and sequence numbers are Kotlin Long; optional input fields localeId/noSpeechTimeoutMs must be explicitly present, including null

methods.capabilities: Pure Android API/permission/STT/on-device availability/assets/ABI lookup; onDeviceSttAvailable is explicitly null below API 31; no permission prompt, JNI/model initialization or microphone
methods.requestRecordPermission: Explicit resumed visible Activity only, returns granted bool; never chains permission completion to capture or automatic resume
methods.armWake: ownerId/generation/armId; returns null only after real model hash verification, stream creation and AudioRecord.startRecording; stop during loading/start waits for resource close and actual worker join
methods.recognizeOnce: ownerId/generation/requestId/purpose/localeId/listenForMs/pauseForMs/noSpeechTimeoutMs; normal default SpeechRecognizer service, free-form partial results and selected locale; starts only with no previous capture owner
methods.finishRecognition: Own request only; stopListening then genuine native terminal + destroy, or 2-second grace destroy; no partial-to-final promotion
methods.cancelRecognition: Own request only; revoke callbacks before main-looper cancel/destroy; a late request ID cannot affect a replacement request
methods.stop: Pass the canceled generation, not a new replacement generation; synchronous revocation, wake close/join and recognizer cancel/destroy before stopped/ack; stale older-generation stop fails staleOwner without touching replacement

ownership.nativeOwner: none | wake | speech, including a process-wide atomic lease across Flutter engine replacements
ownership.wakeThread: One AudioRecord/decode thread plus an off-main control executor that actually joins it; no main-thread model work, decode or join
ownership.wakeCapture: MIC, 16000 Hz mono PCM16, 1600-sample frames, bounded 200-ms AudioRecord buffer, short / 32768.0f; no pre-roll, PCM persistence, channel PCM or audio network
ownership.wakeEngine: Real sherpa-onnx 2.0.1 KeywordSpotter/OnlineStream using exact frozen zipformer2/int8 assets, all frozen parameters and literal keyword bytes
ownership.speech: Create/listen/stop/cancel/destroy confined to main looper; recognitionReady only onReadyForSpeech; isFinal=true only onResults; destroy precedes recognitionEnded
ownership.timers: Injectable monotonic Handler scheduler; readiness 5000 ms, bounded initial/manual/spoken duration, follow-up maximum from readiness, separate final-result grace 2000 ms; canceled on revocation
ownership.nativeLifecycle: onPause, Activity detachment, event consumer cancellation and Flutter engine detachment revoke capture independently of Dart; onResume opens a foreground gate only, never restarts a stopped generation
ownership.rejectedCommands: Malformed/stale/busy method calls return a PlatformException with contract code; they do not emit a misleading fatal error event while another microphone owner remains active

dartIntegration: Subscribe to the event channel before capture and share this native owner for Android manual and hands-free dictation; never concurrently run the previous speech_to_text Android owner
Treat armWake/recognizeOnce as actual-start barriers, finish/cancel/stop as actual owned-release barriers; handle PlatformException on stale commands
Use a fresh monotonic generation after any stop, native lifecycle revocation or fatal error; operation IDs cannot be reused within a generation
Revalidate route/account/session/foreground/consent after every await; permission grant after lifecycle revocation is setup only
Only genuine final plus recognitionEnded from the exact current request may authorize submission; manual results remain draft-only
TTS, chat admission, response-turn ownership and follow-up orchestration remain Dart responsibilities; native has no submission callback or credentials

buildInputs.preparation: Gradle prepareVoiceInputs is a task-backed AAR dependency and preBuild/assets prerequisite; executes scripts/prepare_voice_inputs.py with fixed asset IDs, full archive hashes and selected-file hashes
buildInputs.freshCheckout: Python 3 stdlib only; exact fixed URLs with fixed asset-ID fallback; default build cache ~/.cache/hermes-voice, all hits reverified; output ignored build/voice-inputs
buildInputs.offline: Set HERMES_VOICE_INPUT_DIR to the directory containing the two exact pinned archives, or preseed HERMES_VOICE_CACHE; no untracked model source dependency
buildInputs.apk: All three distributed Flutter ABIs get sherpa/ONNX Runtime JNI; explicit R8 JNI keep rule, uncompressed native libraries and selected model assets; APK packages original model README, Apache/MIT text, source revision and per-file SHA manifest
buildInputs.licensing: Exact model README declares Apache License 2.0; sherpa Apache-2.0, ONNX Runtime MIT. Pinned prebuilt/source-build entry points are not F-Droid acceptance or byte-reproducibility claims

verificationCommands: gradle -p android :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:assembleRelease -Ptarget-platform=android-arm,android-arm64,android-x64 --console=plain (requires normal SDK/local.properties configuration; release must remain unsigned without key.properties)
SDK zipalign -c -P 16 -v 4 on the actual unsigned release APK, plus ELF PT_LOAD, packaged model/notices and R8 class-descriptor inspection
evidence: Actual logs, attempt source hashes, complete native XML reports, clean network-fetch proof, APK inspection and commit-specific handoff.json live outside source in the parent's evidence/voice-native namespace
remainingGates: Parent owns integrated Dart/Flutter suite and PR creation
Parent owns the separate actual Android AAR/JNI fixture probe; this branch adds no redundant instrumentation runner or dependencies
Physical Android 14-16 human microphone/acoustics/privacy/provider/TTS/lifecycle testing remains required
Battery, thermal, real-noise/accent false accepts/recall, latency/memory and Bluetooth/car routing are unmeasured
APK ZIP/ELF 16-KB alignment inspection is not a real 16-KB-page device launch
